chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Jameel ibn Darraj, from one of our companions, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them), who said:
There is no problem with a man departing at night if he is afraid (for his safety).

key_terms.إِفَاضَة: The ritual departure from Muzdalifa to Mina

ai.seo_question: When is it permissible to leave Muzdalifa before dawn during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi outlines a specific legal concession (rukhsah) allowing pilgrims to depart Muzdalifa before dawn if they fear for their safety, such as from overcrowding or injury. It highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on practical ease (yusr) within ritual obligations, balancing the general preference for staying until dawn with the preservation of well-being.
